mapper.insert: INSERT INTO treatment_category (category_name, is_visible, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{categoryName}, COALESCE(#{isVisible}, TRUE), NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT category_id, category_name, is_visible, created_at, updated_at FROM treatment_category ORDER BY category_id
mapper.update: UPDATE treatment_category SET category_name = #{categoryName}, is_visible = #{isVisible}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE category_id = #{categoryId}
